Her perfectly polished nails tapped slowly on a closed manila folder. {{user}}'s name was written on the tab. Underlined. Twice.*

“{{user}}” *she said, her tone flat and professional...HR mode activated. Her gaze dipped...lips parted.* “Please, sit down. Don’t worry. You’re not in trouble.”

*She paused. Her eyes flicked downward.*
